title: Maiden Archetypes
name: Maiden
summary: Beginning and becoming; the task is to meet life with wonder and discernment.
essence: Fresh perception, experimentation, and the courage to make a first choice.

items.name: Adventurer
items.gifts: The tempest current: freedom, range, and intelligent risk.
items.growthPath: Use daring to expand life and prudence to preserve what makes expansion possible.
practices: Before a leap, name the value, the risk, and the exit.
Take one bounded risk instead of manufacturing a crisis.

shadows.name: Reckless Wanderer
description: Daring becomes compulsive without prudence. She chases intensity, changes direction to escape limits, and calls collateral damage freedom. The next horizon matters more than promises, resources, or the nervous systems of those traveling with her.
declarations: I will deal with consequences later.
Stillness means I am trapped.
Commitments should not limit me.
balancing: Build a margin of time, money, and consent.
Ask whether the impulse expands or avoids life.
Complete one commitment before opening another.
shadows.gift: Her appetite for the unknown becomes bold, adaptive leadership when it accepts consequence.

shadows.name: Sheltered Dreamer
description: Daring goes dormant while prudence becomes a shelter from experience. She rehearses journeys, catalogs dangers, and waits for a confidence that action alone could build. Safety gradually narrows into a life observed rather than inhabited.
declarations: The conditions are not right yet.
Preparation is the responsible choice.
Other people are built for risk.
balancing: Choose an adventure small enough to do now.
Limit research and book the next step.
Measure risk against the cost of staying still.
shadows.gift: Her foresight becomes sound expedition craft when it carries her beyond the threshold.

mature.title: Mature Adventurer
paragraphs: The Mature Adventurer can leave familiar ground without abandoning responsibility. She prepares enough, listens to changing conditions, and knows the difference between a calling and an escape. Her freedom includes the capacity to return, repair, and remain when depth asks more courage than novelty.

declarations: My freedom can keep a promise.
I prepare for risk without worshiping safety.
I move toward growth, not merely away from discomfort.
I can change course without fleeing consequence.

balance.qualities: Adventurous, Resilient, Free-spirited, Thoughtful, Resourceful, Adaptable, Bold, Wise, Spirited, Grounded

virtues.title: Daring
paragraphs: Daring supplies the energy to cross a real threshold despite uncertainty.

virtues.title: Prudence
paragraphs: Prudence protects people, resources, and future choices without making safety the supreme value.

items.name: Maiden
items.growthPath: Let experience educate innocence without extinguishing it.
practices: Name what delights you and one fact that grounds it.
Make one small choice before seeking reassurance.

shadows.name: Naive Enthusiast
description: Wonder outruns discernment. She rushes toward novelty, promises trust before it is earned, and treats warning signs as failures of imagination. Her openness is real, but without judgment it recruits other people to absorb consequences she has not considered.
declarations: If it feels exciting, it must be right.
Caution only ruins the magic.
Someone will help if this goes wrong.
balancing: Pause long enough to name the likely cost.
Let trust grow from observed behavior.
Keep delight and decline what is unsafe.
shadows.gift: Her readiness to begin becomes courageous openness once it can learn from evidence.

shadows.name: Frozen Beginner
description: Wonder collapses beneath relentless discernment. She studies every doorway but enters none, confusing the absence of risk with wisdom. By demanding certainty before experience, she prevents the very learning that could make her judgment sound.
declarations: I need to know more before I begin.
A wrong choice would expose me.
It is safer to stay uncommitted.
balancing: Set a deadline for ordinary decisions.
Treat mistakes as information, not identity.
shadows.gift: Her care becomes grounded preparation when it supports a real beginning.

mature.title: Mature Maiden
paragraphs: The Mature Maiden meets what is new with delight and tested judgment. She can be moved without being swept away, ask for guidance without surrendering choice, and revise her view without shame. Her innocence is not ignorance; it is the renewed capacity to encounter life directly.

declarations: I welcome surprise and notice what is true.
I let trust grow at the pace of evidence.
I can begin before I know the ending.
My no protects the sincerity of my yes.

balance.qualities: Fresh, Curious, Trusting, Open-hearted, Playful, Hopeful, Receptive, Wise, Discerning, Grounded

virtues.title: Wonder
paragraphs: Wonder keeps perception fresh and makes room for possibilities habit might miss.

virtues.title: Discernment
paragraphs: Discernment compares intuition with evidence, limits, and lived consequence.

items.name: Young Visionary
items.gifts: The young oracle: intuitive pattern-sensing ready to be tested in life.
items.growthPath: Receive impressions freely, then verify, translate, and revise them.
practices: Record an intuition alongside evidence for and against it.
Offer insight as a question or possibility, not a verdict.

shadows.name: Inflated Oracle
description: Intuition escapes verification and becomes self-importance. She treats emotion, coincidence, and desire as privileged revelation, then pressures others to organize their choices around her certainty. Mystery is used to close inquiry rather than deepen it.
declarations: My knowing does not need to be questioned.
Doubt means you are not ready for the truth.
Every sign confirms my path.
balancing: State the observation separately from its meaning.
Invite disconfirming evidence from trusted people.
Let predictions be specific enough to learn from.
shadows.gift: Her confidence in subtle perception becomes clear guidance when it remains corrigible.

shadows.name: Self-Doubting Seer
description: Intuition is dismissed before verification can even begin. She notices patterns and bodily signals, then explains them away to avoid being wrong or visible. Skepticism no longer tests the gift; it prevents the gift from entering conversation.
declarations: It is probably nothing.
I should not trust what I cannot prove yet.
Someone else will see more clearly.
balancing: Name the impression without claiming certainty.
Track intuitive hits and misses over time.
Act on low-stakes signals to build calibration.
shadows.gift: Her humility becomes honest epistemic care when it does not require self-silencing.

mature.title: Mature Young Visionary
paragraphs: The Mature Young Visionary holds intuition as a living hypothesis. She listens to dreams, cycles, symbols, and the body, then asks what reality confirms. She offers what she sees in usable language and welcomes correction, allowing genuine insight to become more precise through relationship.

declarations: I honor intuition without making it infallible.
I can be insightful and mistaken.
I translate symbols into grounded choices.
My gift helps others hear their own knowing.

balance.qualities: Visionary, Intuitive, Humble, Attuned, Imaginative, Grounded, Clear, Curious, Wise, Purposeful

virtues.title: Intuition
paragraphs: Intuition notices patterns before the analytical mind can fully explain them.

virtues.title: Verification
paragraphs: Verification keeps insight answerable to evidence, impact, and revision.
